nodes.title: 🟦✨ Model Tuner ___ README
widgets_values:
WHAT IT DOES:
• Adjusts the strength of entire block groups in the model (Blocks 1-6, Text Fusion, Time Embed, Projection).

HOW TO USE:
1. Mode: Use 'Soft Value' for gentle changes or 'Real Value' for direct scaling.
2. Sliders: 0.00 means no change (1.0x baseline). Move above 0 to strengthen a group, below 0 to weaken it.
3. Optional: Use 'vectors_override' or 'granular_json' for advanced custom values.

nodes.title: 🟦🌪️ Model Sub-Block Chaos Tuner ___ README
widgets_values:
WHAT IT DOES:
• Adds random changes to specific parts of a block to discover new styles, textures, and details.

HOW TO USE:
1. Select the 'target_block' and 'sub_block'.
2. 'chaos_strength': Sets how strong the random effect is.
3. Sliders (0.0 to 1.0): Set the chance that each part receives random changes.
4. Change the 'seed' to generate different variations.

nodes.title: 🟨✨ CLIP Tuner ___ README
widgets_values:
WHAT IT DOES:
• Adjusts the strength of the text encoder layers (Embedding, Layers 1 to 7).

HOW TO USE:
1. Mode: 'Soft Value' is recommended for text stability.
2. Layers 1-2 affect basic words and syntax.
3. Layers 3-5 affect relationships and attributes.
4. Layers 6-7 affect overall style and composition.
5. Sliders: 0.00 = no change. Move above 0 to boost, below 0 to reduce.

nodes.title: 🟨🔬 CLIP Sub-Block Tuner ___ README
widgets_values:
WHAT IT DOES:
• Adjusts specific Attention and MLP parts inside a single CLIP layer.

HOW TO USE:
1. Select the 'target_layer' and 'sub_layer'.
2. Move the slider for the specific part you want to tune (e.g. ATTN_q_proj, MLP_gate_proj).
3. 0.00 = no change.

nodes.title: 🟨🌪️ CLIP Sub-Block Chaos Tuner ___ README
widgets_values:
WHAT IT DOES:
• Adds small random changes to text encoder layers to get alternative interpretations of your prompt.

HOW TO USE:
1. Select the 'target_layer' and 'sub_layer'.
2. Keep 'chaos_strength' low (0.05 to 0.15) so prompts stay readable.
3. Set the chance sliders (0.0 to 1.0) for the parts you want to randomize.
4. Change the 'seed' to try different prompt interpretations.

nodes.title: 🟪🔮 LoRA Block Loader ___ README
widgets_values:
WHAT IT DOES:
• Loads a LoRA and lets you turn it on or off for whole block groups.

HOW TO USE:
1. Select your LoRA file and set the main Model / CLIP strength.
2. Set block sliders to 1.0 for full LoRA strength, or 0.0 to completely disable the LoRA on that block.

nodes.title: 🟦🟨📂 Preset Loader ___ README
widgets_values:
WHAT IT DOES:
• Loads and applies a lightweight (.json) tuning preset onto your Model and CLIP.
• Restores scalar layer offsets and deterministically reproduces bit-exact Chaos perturbation masks.

HOW TO USE:
1. 'preset': Select the .json preset file from the dropdown.
2. 'strength_model': Global scaling multiplier for Model patches (1.0 = 100%, 0.5 = 50%, 1.5 = amplified).
3. 'strength_clip': Global scaling multiplier for CLIP text encoder patches.
4. Presets can be stacked with other tuners downstream or monitored on Visualizers.

nodes.title: 🟦🟨💾 Preset Saver ___ README
widgets_values:
WHAT IT DOES:
• Exports all active Model, CLIP, and Chaos tunings into a lightweight (~1-2 KB) .json preset file.
• Allows instant sharing and reloading of complex tuning setups without saving multi-gigabyte models.

HOW TO USE:
1. Connect your tuned Model and CLIP outputs to this node.
2. 'preset_name': Name of the preset (saved to 'models/arthemy_presets/').
3. 'author': Your creator name or handle.
4. Active LoRAs are excluded from presets; use Model Baker / Saver to bake LoRA weights permanently.

nodes.title: 🟦🔬 Model Sub-Block Tuner ___ README
widgets_values:
WHAT IT DOES:
• Adjusts specific internal parts inside a single model block (Attention Q/K/V/Out, SwiGLU MLP, Norms).

HOW TO USE:
1. Select the 'target_block' and 'sub_block' you want to change.
2. Adjust the sliders for the specific parts you want to tune (0.00 = no change).
3. Connect multiple nodes in a row if you need to edit more than one sub-block.

nodes.title: 🟪🔬 Load Sub-Block LoRA ___ README
widgets_values:
WHAT IT DOES:
• Loads a LoRA only on specific internal parts of a single block (e.g. keep only Attention, or only MLP).

HOW TO USE:
1. Select your LoRA, 'target_block', and 'sub_block'.
2. Set sliders to 1.0 for parts you want to keep, or 0.0 for parts you want to disable.

nodes.title: 🟪🌪️ Load Sub-Block Chaos LoRA ___ README
widgets_values:
WHAT IT DOES:
• Randomly applies parts of a LoRA to create blended styles without typical LoRA artifacts.

HOW TO USE:
1. Select your LoRA, 'target_block', and 'sub_block'.
2. 'base_chance': Sets the default chance (0.0 to 1.0) for all parts.
3. Use component sliders to customize chances for specific parts.
4. Change the 'seed' to test different random combinations.

nodes.title: 🟦🟨🔄 Reset Patcher  ___ README
widgets_values:
WHAT IT DOES:
• Clears all active patches and LoRAs from the model and CLIP.
• Gives you a clean starting point for your tuning nodes.

HOW TO USE:
1. Place this right after your Model and CLIP loaders.
2. Keep both 'reset_model' and 'reset_clip' set to True.
3. Connect its outputs to your first tuner or visualizer node.
